# sendgrid_custom_field (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid Marketing Campaigns custom contact field definition. Accounts are limited to 500 custom fields. Field names must be case-insensitively unique and cannot collide with SendGrid's reserved field names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_custom_field" "shoe_size" {
  name       = "shoe_size"
  field_type = "Number"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field_type` (String) The field's data type: `Text`, `Number`, or `Date`. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `name` (String) The field name. Must be alphanumeric/underscore and start with a letter or underscore.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The custom field's ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_custom_field.shoe_size <custom_field_id>
```
